title: Explicit bound for symmetric point configurations on the sphere
exact_target: Give an explicit size bound for symmetric spherical point sets outside the exceptional circle configurations and decide whether the soccer-ball vertices are maximal.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000004 (AMR-099-0004). CC BY 4.0.
